__doc: S180 — the tracked baseline for `php scripts/assertion-escape-audit.php --probe`.
This file exists so that the UNDECIDED half of the probe census is a CHECKED FACT
instead of prose. Both directions red the gate: an observed NOT-REACHED that is not
listed here, AND a listed entry that has started gating or has disappeared. A
known-issues list that only ever grows is how a gate becomes a permanent hole.
NOTHING HERE CAN SILENCE A `VACUOUS` OR `DEGRADED` VERDICT. Those are the findings
the gate exists for and they have no opt-out, by the same reasoning as
opt-out'. `excluded` removes a site from the run entirely; it does not whitelist a
Sites are keyed on file + method, never on a line number: line numbers move on every
unrelated edit above them, and a baseline that needs re-blessing after every refactor

notReached.reason: The site is `$this->fail('unexpected query during a refresh: ' . $sql)` — the closure's guard against a THIRD query that must not happen. The two queries the test does make are handled by the two `if` arms above it, so the probed line is unreachable on the passing path BY DESIGN; making it run would mean breaking the behaviour under test. Deterministic on every box: this Integration test uses a mocked Workerman\MySQL\Connection and touches no database, so it probes NOT-REACHED with and without MySQL (both measured 2026-08-03).

S120 census site 10. The site is `$this->fail('no INSERT expected — the users fallback resolved: ' . $sql)` in a branch that is not supposed to be taken. The closure ITSELF is not in a swallowing context — S120 established that by execution: a tripwire planted at the closure's opening brace DID run and took the test red naming its own message. So the undecidedness is about this one guard line, not about the closure. Mocked connection, no database, deterministic on every box.

S120 census site 14. The closure is NEVER INVOKED — that is the assertion: `$db2->method('query')->willReturnCallback(fn => $this->fail('Second instance should use cached data, not query DB'))` proves the second LibraryManager reads the shared cache instead of querying. S120 confirmed by planting a tripwire at the closure's opening brace: still not reached. A probe cannot decide a closure that must not run; the test's proof IS its non-execution. Mocked connection, no database, deterministic on every box.
